title: oreocalamus armatus
intro: Oreocalamus armatus, commonly known as the Himalayan Club Moss, is a type of plant that belongs to the lycopodiophyta phylum. The plant has been found to have various health benefits, including its ability to lower blood pressure and cholesterol levels, as well as its anti-inflammatory properties. Therapeutically, Oreocalamus armatus has been used to treat conditions such as fever, cough, and skin irritations, with its therapeutic actions attributed to its antimicrobial and antioxidant properties. The plant's bioactive constituents include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
